# lodash.uniq v4.5.0

The [lodash](https://example.invalid/) method `_.uniq` exported as a [Node.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:
```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash.uniq
```

In Node.js:
```js
var uniq = require('lodash.uniq');
```

See the [documentation](https://example.invalid/docs#uniq) or [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/4.5.0-npm-packages/lodash.uniq) for more details.
